A same-existing thing is a now-existing thing continuing from its own unique prior-existing. 6. A set is a gathering of things all qualifying by the same definition. 7. A universal set is the set of all things qualifying by the same definition. 8. The universe is the set of all now-existing things. 9. A subset of a set is a set containing only things in that set. 10. A living universal set is a now-and-same-existing universal set. — For resolving 11. A living set remains living while things are in the set. — For resolving 12. Alternating is changing between two things. 13. Observing is distinguishing changing is-or-is-not. 14. Only next-existing is in the priority possibility universal set. 19. A self is a same-existing universal set of its own prior-existing parities. 20. Other is-not self. 21. There are only two possible methods of same-existing. — For resolving 24. Prioritizing is remaining as one of these two until changing to the other of these two and alternating as same-existing. 25. A living thing is a same-existing thing with its own prior-existing parities. 26. This self’s possibility universal set is the set of all this self’s next-and-same-possible-existings. — For resolving 27. Prioritizing next-existing is same-existing. 34. Paritizing same-existing is next-existing. 35. Living is prior-now-next prioritizing and paritizing. 36. Prioritizing and paritizing are both living at all momentaries of living self. 37. Prioritizing and paritizing are alternating is-or-is-not changing. 38. Self’s next-priority is other’s next-parity. 39. Other’s next-priority is self’s next-parity. 40. A society is a living set of living selves. — For resolving 41. The society’s method is living in the society, not in any self alone. — For resolving 42. A competency is possibly self-observable and other-observable. 43. A self-competency is a method of prior-existing prioritizing, paritizing and prioritizing. 44. A self-competency is self-and-other-observable.
